itemized.notes: October pre-general report; the largest 2012 filing. CONTINUATION SHEETS: this filer's Form A and Form B each run over several sheets that carry a printed 'Page n of m' and NO per-sheet subtotal - only the final sheet prints the grand total, so the completeness gate here is the multi-sheet sum, not a page subtotal. In-kind rows are tagged 'In Kind' in the right margin and are mirrored one-for-one between Form A and Form B (the form instructs exactly that). This variant's Form B has no Purpose column, so `purpose` is honestly empty. Donor street addresses printed on the schedule are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md: the structured layer stores donor city/state only).
